rationale: The core statistics match the reference exactly: one DESeqDataSet on all twelve samples, ~condition vs ~1 LRT for the any-difference question, and two named Wald contrasts against an explicitly releveled control from the same fit, with BH within each test kept separate — no subsetting into pairwise eights and no conflation of LRT p-values with pairwise fold changes. QC (blind VST, PCA, sample distances, library sizes, explicit flagging rather than silent dropping) precedes the model, and the >=10 counts in >=4 samples filter is minimal and justified by the smallest group size. Normalization is never named: raw counts go into DESeq2 and nothing is pre-normalized, but median-of-ratios size factors are only implicit, which is a stated-vs-done gap. The shrinkage plan is sound though the apeglm rationale is wrong — treated_a vs control and treated_b vs control against a releveled reference are single coefficients, so apeglm does apply; ashr is still a defensible uniform choice. Enrichment was not asked for and is not clearly warranted here, and ranking by the unsigned LRT statistic is a directionless ranking that fgsea will misinterpret, though the pairwise Wald-stat rankings, universe intersection, size window, collection versions and no-pooling rule are well specified; the report step is thorough on design, thresholds, counts, diagnostics and reproducibility.
